full.description: This is a microscopic image of liver tissue stained with an acid-fast stain. The image shows numerous magenta-colored, rod-shaped bacilli packed within macrophages or scattered throughout the tissue. These findings are characteristic of mycobacterial infection, such as tuberculosis or Mycobacterium avium complex, involving the liver.

random.description: This is a microscopic pathology image showing tissue stained to highlight microorganisms. Numerous magenta-colored, rod-shaped bacilli are densely clustered inside macrophages or extracellularly throughout the specimen. The appearance is characteristic of an acid-fast stain demonstrating mycobacteria. The most likely diagnosis is mycobacterial infection, such as tuberculosis or leprosy, depending on the clinical context.
